summary: Both backend (14/14 pytest tests pass) and frontend flows verified for Corner Model 2.0. Auth, leagues, teams, fixtures, odds/EV, scanner, and all UI interactions (login, dashboard, scanner filters + row navigation, fixture detail quick-paste odds + inline odds + team breakdown tabs) work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_data() is idempotent only on empty DB (count check). Fine for MVP but if leagues collection is partially seeded/modified, no re-seeding occurs.
auth_session endpoint uses session_token from Emergent response directly - no rotation; acceptable as tokens come from OAuth provider.
server.py is ~430 lines — approaching but under the 700-line threshold; consider splitting model/auth/routes into modules if it grows.
test_credentials: Emergent Google OAuth (no passwords). Backend tests use direct mongosh-inserted session token per /app/auth_testing.md.
seed_data_creation: Auto-seeds on backend startup: 7 leagues, 70 teams, 35 fixtures, ~28 fixtures pre-seeded with odds. Test inserts one user + session, cleans up after.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py cover auth, leagues, teams (splits/windows), fixtures, EV formula & tier, scanner sort/filter. Use mongosh per /app/auth_testing.md to create session token for API/browser testing. Frontend verified via cookie auth.
